name: CountdownTimer
shortDescription: Configurable countdown timer with arc progress ring
longDescription: A classroom-friendly countdown timer. Set hours, minutes, and seconds, then start the countdown. Features an animated arc progress ring showing remaining time. Start, pause, and reset controls.

name: RandomPicker
shortDescription: Random name/number picker with animation
longDescription: Pick a random item from a list. Enter names or numbers separated by commas, tap the big Pick button, and watch as names flash by before settling on a random winner.

name: Scoreboard
shortDescription: Two-team score tracker with winner highlight
longDescription: Track scores for two teams with large score displays. Use plus and minus buttons to adjust each team's score. The leading team is highlighted. Includes a reset button to start a new game.

name: QuizBuzzer
shortDescription: Single tap quiz buzzer with lockout
longDescription: A simple quiz buzzer system. Tap the big Buzz button and see who answered first. Once someone buzzes in, the system locks out others until reset. Perfect for quiz competitions.

name: ClassReminder
shortDescription: Set periodic classroom reminders
longDescription: Set and manage classroom reminders. Choose a time and message, then add it to your reminder list. Reminders display a popup notification when they trigger. Add and remove reminders as needed.

name: Stopwatch
shortDescription: Lap-capable stopwatch with centiseconds
longDescription: A precise stopwatch with lap timing. Start, stop, and reset with easy-to-tap buttons. Record lap times that display in a scrollable list. Shows elapsed time down to centiseconds.

name: DiceRoller
shortDescription: Virtual dice roller with multiple dice types
longDescription: Roll virtual dice for tabletop games and classroom activities. Choose from d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, or d20 dice. Tap Roll to get an animated random result. Multiple dice selectable at once.

name: GroupMaker
shortDescription: Random group assignment tool
longDescription: Create random groups from a list of names. Enter names separated by commas, choose the number of groups or group size, and generate random assignments. Perfect for classroom group activities.

name: FlashCards
shortDescription: Flashcard viewer with flip animation
longDescription: Study with digital flashcards. Browse through pre-loaded question and answer cards for common subjects including math, science, and vocabulary. Tap Flip to reveal the answer, and use Next and Previous to navigate cards.

name: AttendanceTracker
shortDescription: Class attendance check-in tracker
longDescription: Track student attendance with a simple check-in list. Tap each name to toggle present or absent status. See a summary of present and absent counts at the top. Pre-loaded with a sample class roster.

name: MathQuiz
shortDescription: Random arithmetic quiz with difficulty levels and scoring
longDescription: Test your math skills with random arithmetic quizzes. Choose difficulty (easy/medium/hard), answer using the number pad, and track your score.

name: TimerRelay
shortDescription: Multi-stage relay timer for classroom activities
longDescription: A configurable multi-stage relay timer. Set up multiple timed stages that run sequentially, with visual and audio alerts between stages.

name: WordScramble
shortDescription: Unscramble letters to form words, with hints and timer
longDescription: A word scramble puzzle game. Letters are shuffled and the player must rearrange them to form the correct word. Includes hints and a countdown timer.

name: VotingPoll
shortDescription: Simple yes/no/multiple-choice voting with result bar chart
longDescription: A classroom voting and polling app. Create polls with multiple options, collect votes, and display results as visual bar charts.

name: PeriodicTable
shortDescription: Interactive periodic table of elements reference
longDescription: An interactive periodic table of elements. Tap any element to view its atomic number, symbol, name, and atomic mass. Browse by groups and periods.

name: UnitConverter
shortDescription: Length, mass, temperature, volume unit converter
longDescription: A multi-category unit conversion tool. Convert between common units for length, mass, temperature, and volume with real-time results.

name: SoundMeter
shortDescription: Simulated decibel meter for classroom noise monitoring
longDescription: A simulated sound level meter for classroom use. Displays current noise level as a decibel reading with visual gauge and color-coded indicators.

name: SpinWheel
shortDescription: Colorful spinning wheel for random prizes/activities
longDescription: A colorful spinning prize wheel. Tap to spin and land on a random segment. Customizable segments for prizes, activities, or student names.

name: GradeCalc
shortDescription: Grade calculator with weighted categories
longDescription: A grade calculator supporting weighted categories. Enter assignment scores and category weights to compute overall course grade.

name: SeatingChart
shortDescription: Simple drag-to-arrange classroom seating layout
longDescription: A classroom seating chart tool. Tap positions on a grid to assign student names and create visual seating arrangements for classroom management.

name: TicTacToe
shortDescription: 3x3 Tic Tac Toe, two-player game
longDescription: Classic Tic Tac Toe on a 3x3 grid. Two players alternate X and O marks. Win detection for rows, columns and diagonals. Score tracking for X, O and draws. New Game and Reset Score buttons.

name: MemoryMatch
shortDescription: 4x4 card flip memory matching game
longDescription: Memory matching game with 4x4 grid (8 pairs). Cards face down, tap to flip. Find matching pairs. Move counter. Emoji symbols used for matches.

name: NumberGuess
shortDescription: Guess a secret number 1-100
longDescription: Guess the secret number between 1 and 100. Number pad input, higher/lower hints, guess counter. New Game button to restart.

name: ReactionTest
shortDescription: Test your reaction time
longDescription: Tap when screen changes color. Random delay before color change. Measures reaction time in milliseconds. Tracks best time.

name: MazeRunner
shortDescription: Navigate an 8x8 maze to the goal
longDescription: Navigate a player through an 8x8 maze to reach the goal. Directional buttons (up/down/left/right) for movement. Programmatically generated maze.

name: SnakeGame
shortDescription: Classic snake on a 10x10 grid
longDescription: Classic snake game on a 10x10 grid. Direction controls, food spawning, growing tail, wall collision, score tracking. Timer-based movement.

name: TapSpeed
shortDescription: How many taps in 10 seconds?
longDescription: Tap as many times as you can in 10 seconds. Big tap target area, countdown timer, final score, high score tracking.

name: RockPaperScissors
shortDescription: Play rock-paper-scissors vs computer
longDescription: Play rock-paper-scissors against the computer. Three buttons for your choice. Computer picks randomly. Result display and score tracking.

name: ColorMatch
shortDescription: Stroop test - match the ink color
longDescription: Stroop test challenge. Display a color name in a different color. Tap the button matching the INK color (not the word). Score and timer.

name: MathDuel
shortDescription: Two-player math race game
longDescription: Two-player math race. Shared display shows a math problem. Each player has a Buzz button. First to buzz gets to answer. Score tracking for both players.

name: FallingBlocks
shortDescription: Catch falling blocks with paddle
longDescription: Blocks fall from the top of the screen. Move the paddle left and right to catch them. Score points for each block caught and try not to miss any!

name: PatternRepeat
shortDescription: Simon-says memory game with colored buttons
longDescription: Watch the sequence of colored buttons light up, then repeat the pattern by tapping the buttons in the same order. Each round adds one more step to the sequence. How far can you go?

name: WordSearch
shortDescription: Find hidden words in letter grid
longDescription: Find the hidden words in an 8x8 grid of letters. Words can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal. Tap letter tiles to select them and highlight found words. A classic word search puzzle!

name: SlotMachine
shortDescription: Three-reel slot machine game
longDescription: Pull the lever and watch the reels spin! Three columns of symbols scroll rapidly then stop one by one. Match symbols to win. A classic slot machine experience.

name: BubblePop
shortDescription: Pop bubbles before they float away
longDescription: Colorful bubbles float up from the bottom. Tap them to pop before they reach the top! Score points for each bubble popped. Speed increases as you progress. How many can you pop?

name: CardWar
shortDescription: Higher card wins card battle game
longDescription: Draw a card for you and the computer. The higher card wins the round! Classic War card game simplified - just draw and see who gets the higher card. Track your wins and losses.

name: CoinFlip
shortDescription: Virtual coin flip with animation
longDescription: Flip a virtual coin and watch it spin! Choose heads or tails, or just flip for a random result. Brief flipping animation shows the coin spinning before revealing the result. Track your flips.

name: TypingRace
shortDescription: Type words as fast as you can
longDescription: A word is displayed - type it as fast as possible! Timer tracks your speed, WPM is calculated after each word. Build your typing skills with new words each round. Beat your best time!

name: Minesweeper
shortDescription: Classic minesweeper puzzle game
longDescription: Classic Minesweeper on an 8x8 grid with 10 mines. Tap to reveal a cell - numbers show how many mines are adjacent. Long-press to flag suspected mines. Clear all safe cells without hitting a mine to win!

name: Puzzle15
shortDescription: Classic 15-puzzle sliding tile game
longDescription: The classic 15-puzzle! Slide the numbered tiles into the empty space to arrange them in order from 1 to 15. Tap a tile next to the empty space to slide it. Track your moves and try to solve it in as few moves as possible!

name: TempHumidity
shortDescription: Temperature and humidity display with simulated sensor data
longDescription: Displays temperature with color-coded arc gauge and humidity as a bar. Simulated sensor data auto-refreshes with a timer. Refresh button generates new random values.

name: BatteryGauge
shortDescription: Visual battery gauge with simulated battery data
longDescription: Displays a visual battery icon built with styled rectangles, percentage, voltage reading, and charging indicator. All battery data is simulated.

name: AirQuality
shortDescription: AQI air quality meter with simulated PM2.5/PM10 data
longDescription: Color-coded arc gauge displaying AQI levels from green to red zones. Shows PM2.5 and PM10 readings with health advice text based on the current air quality level. All data is simulated.

name: IMUVisualizer
shortDescription: IMU accelerometer and gyroscope visualizer with simulated data
longDescription: Displays X/Y/Z bar graphs for accelerometer and gyroscope data, orientation indicator, and pitch/roll/yaw numbers. Simulated data uses gentle random walk for realistic motion.

name: WiFiScanner
shortDescription: WiFi network scanner with simulated network list
longDescription: Displays a list of WiFi networks with SSID, signal strength bars using styled rectangles, channel, and security type. All networks are pre-loaded simulated data.

name: SystemMonitor
shortDescription: Device resource dashboard with simulated system metrics
longDescription: Displays CPU usage percentage, memory usage bar, uptime counter, and storage usage. Values are simulated with random fluctuations around realistic levels.

name: CompassRose
shortDescription: Digital compass rose with simulated heading
longDescription: Displays a rotating compass rose with cardinal directions (N/S/E/W) and heading degrees. Rotate button changes the simulated heading.

name: Altimeter
shortDescription: Altitude display with simulated elevation and pressure data
longDescription: Displays large altitude number, elevation trend arrow (up/down/steady), and pressure reading. All data is simulated with smooth random walk.

name: LightMeter
shortDescription: Ambient light meter with simulated lux readings
longDescription: Displays lux reading, light level bar gauge, and environment descriptor (dark/dim/bright/sunlight). All values are simulated.

name: Speedometer
shortDescription: Speedometer with analog arc gauge and digital readout
longDescription: Displays analog-style arc gauge (0-120 km/h), digital speed readout, and max speed recording. Speed changes are simulated with smooth variation.

name: HeartRate
shortDescription: Simulated heart rate monitor with BPM display and zone indicator
longDescription: Simulated heart rate monitor showing beats per minute with pulsing heart animation, HR zone indicator (rest/fat burn/cardio/peak), and visual feedback.

name: UVIndex
shortDescription: UV index display with color zones and sun protection advice
longDescription: UV index monitor showing 0-11+ scale with color zones (green to purple), current UV number, and sun protection recommendations.

name: RainGauge
shortDescription: Rainfall accumulation display with daily/weekly/monthly readings
longDescription: Simulated rain gauge showing daily, weekly, and monthly rainfall accumulation in mm with a simple bar chart for weekly data.

name: PowerMeter
shortDescription: Energy consumption meter with watts, kWh and cost estimation
longDescription: Simulated power meter showing current wattage, today's energy consumption in kWh, and estimated monthly cost with fluctuating values.

name: Thermometer
shortDescription: Temperature gauge with min/max and trend indicator
longDescription: Simulated thermometer showing large temperature display, daily minimum and maximum, trend arrow indicator, and color-coded reading.

name: Hygrometer
shortDescription: Humidity gauge with comfort zone and color bands
longDescription: Simulated hygrometer showing relative humidity percentage, comfort zone indicator (dry/comfortable/humid), and color-coded bands.

name: Barometer
shortDescription: Atmospheric pressure with trend graph and indicator
longDescription: Simulated barometer showing current atmospheric pressure, trend indicator (rising/falling/steady), and a simple pressure trend graph.

name: DistanceSensor
shortDescription: Ultrasonic distance display with proximity warning
longDescription: Simulated distance sensor showing distance in centimeters, a distance bar indicator (closer objects = longer bar), and a proximity warning.

name: CO2Monitor
shortDescription: CO2 level monitor with color indicator and ventilation advice
longDescription: Simulated CO2 monitor showing PPM reading, color-coded air quality indicator (green/yellow/red), and ventilation recommendations.

name: Multisensor
shortDescription: Combined sensor dashboard with temp, humidity, pressure and light
longDescription: Simulated multisensor dashboard showing temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and ambient light on a single compact screen with card-styled sections.

name: PomodoroTimer
shortDescription: Pomodoro Timer with 25min work / 5min break cycles
longDescription: Focus timer with 25-minute work sessions and 5-minute break intervals. Features countdown display, start/pause/reset controls, session counter, work/break mode indicator, and a visual progress arc.

name: HabitTracker
shortDescription: Daily habit checklist with streaks and completion tracking
longDescription: Track daily habits with pre-loaded habits (Exercise, Read, Meditate, Water, Sleep). Features checkbox-style toggles, streak counters, and day completion percentage.

name: TallyCounter
shortDescription: Simple increment/decrement counter with history log
longDescription: Tally counter with large number display, +1/-1 buttons, reset, and count history log. Perfect for counting people, items, or tracking repetitions.

name: DailyPlanner
shortDescription: Hour-by-hour daily schedule planner (8AM-10PM)
longDescription: Plan your day with an hour-by-hour schedule from 8AM to 10PM. Tap time slots to view and edit schedule items in a scrollable list.

name: MemoPad
shortDescription: Quick notes with save, view, and delete features
longDescription: Jot down quick notes with a text input area and save button. View saved notes as a list, tap to read full note, long-press to delete. Notes are stored in memory.

name: WaterReminder
shortDescription: Hydration tracker with daily 8-glass goal
longDescription: Track your daily water intake with an 8-glass goal. Tap to log each glass, see progress with a bar indicator, and toggle reminder mode.

name: ExpenseTracker
shortDescription: Expense log with categories and daily total
longDescription: Track daily expenses with amount entry, category selection (food/transport/entertainment/other), daily total display, and expense entry list.

name: GroceryList
shortDescription: Shopping list with checkable items
longDescription: Create a grocery shopping list with text input. Add items, tap to cross off completed items, and clear checked items when done.

name: BirthdayReminder
shortDescription: Birthday calendar with countdown to next birthday
longDescription: Keep track of birthdays with a pre-loaded list. View countdown days to each upcoming birthday, sorted by nearest first.

name: IntervalTimer
shortDescription: Workout interval timer with configurable work/rest phases
longDescription: Workout interval timer with configurable work/rest seconds and round count. Displays phase indicator (work/rest), countdown per phase, and remaining rounds.

name: DecisionMaker
shortDescription: Decision helper with spinning animation and coin flip
longDescription: Can't decide? Enter your options, let the spinning wheel pick one for you. Also includes a yes/no/maybe coin flip and a pros/cons list to help you weigh choices.

name: PasswordGen
shortDescription: Password generator with strength indicator
longDescription: Generate secure passwords with customizable length (8-32) and character types (upper/lower/digits/symbols). See real-time strength rating and copy-ready output.

name: QRDisplay
shortDescription: Display text as a visual QR-like pixel pattern
longDescription: Enter any text and see it rendered as a colorful QR-code-like pixel grid pattern. A fun visual toy that turns your words into art.

name: TipCalculator
shortDescription: Bill tip calculator with split-by-people
longDescription: Quickly calculate tips on your bill. Choose from preset percentages (10/15/18/20/25) or enter a custom amount. Split the total among any number of people and see the per-person cost.

name: WorldClock
shortDescription: View times across multiple timezones at a glance
longDescription: Keep track of time in NYC, London, Dubai, Tokyo, and your local timezone. See the current time for each city with AM/PM indicators. Great for coordinating across timezones.

name: AlarmClock
shortDescription: Simple alarm clock with snooze
longDescription: Set an alarm with hour and minute controls. Toggle the alarm on/off, and use the snooze function to catch a few more minutes of rest.

name: CalorieLog
shortDescription: Track daily food calories by meal type
longDescription: Log your meals throughout the day. Select meal type (breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack), enter calorie count, and track your daily total at a glance.

name: CaffeineTracker
shortDescription: Log caffeine intake and stay under 400mg limit
longDescription: Track your daily caffeine consumption. Quick-add drinks like coffee, tea, soda, or energy drinks. See your running total against the recommended 400mg daily max with a progress bar.

name: StepCounter
shortDescription: Simulated pedometer with daily goal tracking
longDescription: Track your simulated steps toward a 10,000 step daily goal. Add steps manually to see your progress bar fill up, and reset each day to start fresh.

name: MedicationReminder
shortDescription: Pill reminder with time picker and name input
longDescription: Never miss your medication. Set reminders with time and medication name, toggle them on/off, and see your full reminder list at a glance.

name: SketchPad
shortDescription: Finger drawing canvas with color picker
longDescription: SketchPad: Draw freely with your finger. Features 8 preset colors, adjustable line width, and a clear button. Uses lv.canvas for smooth drawing experience.

name: ColorPicker
shortDescription: RGB color picker with sliders and hex display
longDescription: ColorPicker: Select colors using RGB sliders. Features red, green, and blue sliders, a live preview swatch, and hex color code display.

name: LEDMatrix
shortDescription: Simulated 8x8 LED grid with toggle and patterns
longDescription: LEDMatrix: An 8x8 simulated LED grid. Tap cells to toggle on/off, choose from preset patterns (heart, arrow, smile), or clear all at once.

name: BounceAnim
shortDescription: Bouncing ball physics animation with trail
longDescription: BounceAnim: A bouncing ball animation with gravity and bounce physics. Includes a fading trail effect and color changes on wall impacts.

name: FireworkShow
shortDescription: Particle firework animation on tap
longDescription: FireworkShow: Tap the screen to launch colorful fireworks. Particles burst outward with gravity and fade effects in multiple vibrant colors.

name: ClockFace
shortDescription: Analog clock with rotating hands
longDescription: ClockFace: A classic analog clock. Features hour, minute, and second hands using rotated objects, tick marks, and a digital time readout below.

name: Slideshow
shortDescription: Colored pattern slideshow with auto-advance
longDescription: Slideshow: Browse through colored pattern slides. Navigate with prev/next buttons and toggle auto-advance mode with a timer.

name: GradientViewer
shortDescription: Linear gradient preview with color selectors
longDescription: GradientViewer: Preview and customize linear gradients. Choose start and end colors, toggle horizontal/vertical orientation, and see the result.

name: StatusPanel
shortDescription: System status dashboard with info cards
longDescription: StatusPanel: A clean system status dashboard. Displays time, date, battery level, WiFi signal, storage info, and uptime in styled card widgets.

name: WeatherIcon
shortDescription: Animated weather icons with shape animation
longDescription: WeatherIcon: Display animated weather condition icons. Cycle through sun, cloud, rain, snow, and thunder icons built from lv.obj shapes with timer-based animations.

name: PixelArt
shortDescription: Small canvas pixel editor with 16x16 grid and color palette
longDescription: A 16x16 pixel art editor. Choose from 8 colors in the palette, tap pixels to paint, use clear and fill buttons. Create pixel art with a simple touch interface.

name: ColorPalette
shortDescription: Browse LVGL palette colors with names and hex values
longDescription: Scrollable grid of all LVGL palette color swatches. Tap any color to see its name and hex value in a preview bar. Useful as a color reference for developers.

name: LoadingSpinner
shortDescription: Loading spinner animation showcase with multiple styles
longDescription: Display different loading spinner styles: rotating arc, bouncing dots, pulsing circle, and progress bar. Cycle through styles with a button. Demonstrates animation techniques with lv.timer.

name: ProgressDemos
shortDescription: Progress widget showcase with bars, arcs, and labels
longDescription: Demonstrates various progress indicator styles: horizontal bar, vertical bar, circular arc, and percentage label. All widgets animate to fill automatically.

name: TextScroller
shortDescription: Marquee text scroller with speed and direction controls
longDescription: Marquee text display that scrolls text horizontally. Features text input, scrolling speed control, start/stop button, direction toggle, and adjustable text size.

name: MatrixRain
shortDescription: Matrix digital rain effect with falling green characters
longDescription: Simulates the iconic Matrix digital rain effect. Green characters fall down the screen at random speeds with varying lengths. Characters change randomly as they fall, creating a dynamic visual effect.

name: Kaleidoscope
shortDescription: Symmetric drawing tool with 4-quadrant mirroring
longDescription: Draw on one quadrant and see your drawing mirrored across all 4 quadrants. Features a brush tool, color selection palette, and clear button. Creates beautiful symmetric patterns.

name: WaveVisualizer
shortDescription: Audio waveform simulator with animated sine/cosine waves
longDescription: Simulates audio waveform visualization with animated sine and cosine waves. Adjust frequency and amplitude with sliders for real-time wave drawing on canvas.

name: ParticleSystem
shortDescription: Interactive particle system with touch-to-emit physics
longDescription: Touch the screen to emit colorful particles from your finger. Particles spread out with simulated physics, fade away over time, and cycle through colors. Demonstrates timer-based particle simulation.

name: MoodLight
shortDescription: Ambient mood light with color presets and brightness control
longDescription: Full-screen ambient mood light with 5 mood presets (Relax, Energize, Focus, Sunset, Night). Features smooth color transition animations and a brightness slider for the perfect ambiance.

name: MultiplicationTable
shortDescription: Interactive times table grid 1-12, tap to reveal answer
longDescription: Interactive multiplication table grid from 1x1 to 12x12. Tap any cell to reveal the product. Uses a button grid layout for easy navigation.

name: FractionVisualizer
shortDescription: Visual fraction bars with numerator/denominator controls
longDescription: Learn fractions visually. Adjust numerator and denominator with buttons and see the fraction represented as a filled bar. Compare multiple fractions side by side.

name: PrimeNumberFinder
shortDescription: Find primes in range with sieve visualization
longDescription: Find prime numbers within a specified range using the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Displays a colored grid showing primes (green) and composites (gray). Adjustable range controls.

name: RomanNumeral
shortDescription: Roman numeral converter and quiz with input buttons
longDescription: Convert between Arabic and Roman numerals. Includes an interactive quiz mode to test your knowledge of Roman numerals from 1 to 3999.

name: GeometryQuiz
shortDescription: Shape identification and area/perimeter quiz
longDescription: Test your geometry knowledge. Identify shapes and calculate area and perimeter. Multiple choice questions with visual shape representations.

name: DecimalBinary
shortDescription: Decimal/binary/hex converter with bit visualization
longDescription: Convert numbers between decimal, binary, and hexadecimal. Features interactive bit toggles to flip individual bits and see the decimal and hex values update in real time.

name: GraphPlotter
shortDescription: Simple coordinate plotter with touch on canvas
longDescription: Plot points on a coordinate grid by touching the canvas. Connect points to visualize graphs. Adjustable axis scale and grid lines.

name: EquationSolver
shortDescription: Linear equation solver with steps display
longDescription: Solve linear equations of the form ax + b = cx + d. Enter coefficients and see step-by-step solution showing each algebraic operation.

name: AngleMeasurer
shortDescription: Protractor tool with angle visualization using arc
longDescription: Interactive protractor for measuring and learning angles. Drag the arc to set an angle from 0 to 360 degrees. Displays angle type (acute, right, obtuse, reflex).

name: PercentageCalc
shortDescription: Percentage calculator with visual pie chart
longDescription: Calculate percentages with a visual pie chart. Enter part and whole values to find percentage, or calculate percentage of a number. The arc updates to show the proportion.

name: LongDivision
shortDescription: Step-by-step long division tutor with labels
longDescription: Learn long division step by step. Enter divisor and dividend, then walk through each step of the division process with visual labels showing the work.

name: SudokuHelper
shortDescription: Sudoku assistant with pencil marks and hints
longDescription: Sudoku solving assistant. Enter a puzzle on the 9x9 grid, add pencil mark candidates, and get hints by eliminating impossible values based on row, column, and box constraints.

name: MathBingo
shortDescription: Bingo card with math problems, tap to mark
longDescription: Math Bingo game. A 5x5 bingo card filled with answers to math problems. Solve the displayed problem, find the answer on your card, and tap to mark it. Get 5 in a row to win.

name: NumberPatterns
shortDescription: Fill-in number sequence patterns quiz
longDescription: Test your pattern recognition skills. Complete number sequences by filling in the missing terms. Patterns include arithmetic, geometric, square numbers, Fibonacci, and more.

name: CountingFrame
shortDescription: Abacus-style counting frame with rows of beads
longDescription: Interactive abacus-style counting frame. Slide beads across rows to represent numbers. Each row represents a place value (ones, tens, hundreds). Tap beads to toggle position.

name: StatisticsCalc
shortDescription: Mean, median, mode, range calculator with input
longDescription: Calculate mean, median, mode, and range for a set of numbers. Enter values via keypad, and see all four statistics computed automatically. Great for homework help.

name: SpellingBee
shortDescription: Spelling practice with word lists and text input
longDescription: Practice spelling with curated word lists. Hear the word (displayed briefly), then type the correct spelling. Track your score and review missed words.

name: SynonymMatch
shortDescription: Match words with synonyms, pair selection game
longDescription: Match words with their synonyms. Select a word from the left column and its matching synonym from the right column. Score points for correct pairs and learn vocabulary.

name: ReadingTimer
shortDescription: Timed reading with WPM calculation and display
longDescription: Improve your reading speed. Display a passage, start the timer, and tap when finished. Calculates words per minute (WPM). Track progress across multiple readings.

name: VocabularyBuilder
shortDescription: Flashcard word learning with category buttons
longDescription: Build your vocabulary with flashcards. Choose a category, see a word, and tap to reveal the definition. Swipe or tap buttons to move between cards. Track learned words.

name: SentenceBuilder
shortDescription: Tap words to build sentences in order
longDescription: Build sentences by tapping word buttons in the correct order. Add your own words or use the built-in word bank. Great for language learning and sentence construction practice.

name: RhymeFinder
shortDescription: Find rhyming words from input text
longDescription: Enter a word and find rhyming words from a built-in dictionary. Displays a list of words that rhyme with your input. Useful for poetry, songwriting, and word play.

name: HaikuWriter
shortDescription: Guided haiku writer with syllable counter
longDescription: Write haiku poems with syllable counting guidance. The classic 5-7-5 syllable pattern is tracked as you type each line. Learn the art of Japanese poetry through interactive writing.

name: StoryDice
shortDescription: Roll dice with words to inspire stories
longDescription: Roll virtual story dice to get random combinations of words and themes. Use the results to spark creativity and write unique stories. Each roll gives a new set of inspiring prompts.

name: WordCloud
shortDescription: Word cloud display sized by frequency
longDescription: Generate a simple word cloud from text input. Words are displayed at different sizes based on how frequently they appear. Visualize the most important words in any text passage.

name: AlphabetRace
shortDescription: Race to type A-Z with timer and errors
longDescription: Race against the clock to type the alphabet from A to Z. Track your time and error count. Beat your personal best and improve your typing speed and accuracy.

name: SolarSystem
shortDescription: Interactive solar system with planet info
longDescription: Explore our solar system with an interactive model. Tap on planets to view information cards about each one. Learn about the planets, their sizes, distances, and fascinating facts.

name: MoonPhase
shortDescription: Moon phase display with 8 phases
longDescription: View the current moon phase with an animated display. Browse through all 8 moon phases from new moon to full moon and back. Learn the names and characteristics of each phase.

name: PlantGrowth
shortDescription: Plant growth tracker with height log
longDescription: Track your plant's growth over time with daily height measurements. Log entries and view a visual progress bar. Monitor how your plant grows day by day and keep a complete growth record.

name: WeatherLogger
shortDescription: Daily weather observation logger
longDescription: Log daily weather observations with icon selection. Record temperature, weather conditions, and notes. Browse your weather log history and track patterns over time.

name: RockClassifier
shortDescription: Rock and mineral classification guide
longDescription: Browse and learn about different rocks and minerals. Explore igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic categories. Tap each rock to see its properties, formation process, and common locations.

name: CircuitSim
shortDescription: Simple circuit diagram builder
longDescription: Build simple circuit diagrams with components like batteries, switches, LEDs, and resistors. Select components and arrange them to learn about basic electrical circuits and how electricity flows.

name: FoodChain
shortDescription: Build food chain diagrams by level
longDescription: Build food chain diagrams with producer, consumer, and decomposer levels. Select organisms for each trophic level and visualize energy flow through ecosystems. Great for biology education.

name: WaterCycle
shortDescription: Animated water cycle diagram
longDescription: Explore the water cycle with an animated diagram showing evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection. Step through each stage to learn how water moves through Earth's systems.

name: HumanBody
shortDescription: Human body systems reference guide
longDescription: Interactive reference guide to human body systems. Browse the skeletal, muscular, circulatory, respiratory, digestive, and nervous systems. Learn about organs and their functions.

name: ConstellationMap
shortDescription: Star constellation reference guide
longDescription: Explore star constellations with connect-the-dots star pattern displays. Browse famous constellations, learn their names, see their star patterns, and read the mythology behind each one.

name: PhScale
shortDescription: pH scale 0-14 with color gradient
longDescription: Explore the pH scale from 0 to 14 with an interactive color gradient display. See where common substances fall on the scale. Learn about acids, bases, and neutral substances.

name: MagnetismLab
shortDescription: Virtual magnet and compass simulation
longDescription: Explore magnetism with a virtual magnet and compass needle simulation. Drag the magnet to see how the compass responds. Learn about magnetic poles, attraction, and repulsion.

name: MicroscopeSim
shortDescription: Simulated microscope with zoom controls
longDescription: Simulate a microscope view with zoom and focus controls. Explore different virtual slides including plant cells, pond water microorganisms, and fabric fibers. Adjust magnification to see more detail.

name: DinoEncyclopedia
